name: lifestyle-startup-system
description: Lifestyle Startup System — turn your skill into a product you can scale. Nine steps, one skill each: find the idea, shape the offer, set the brand and design system, prototype the key flows on a canvas, plan the build, check security, go live, and grow. Every step writes one numbered document to your docs/ folder.
